name: gradient-phoenix-start

frames.best_why: The full vertical blend is clear, from golden yellow at the top to red-orange at the bottom.

tagline: Golden yellow at the top melts down into red-orange across a rounded panel.
summary: A decorative vertical gradient block that glows golden yellow at the top edge and warms through amber and orange to red-orange at the bottom, with soft rounded corners.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle with a vertical gradient: bright golden yellow along the top edge, warming through amber and orange to a red-orange along the bottom. Black margins frame it.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The two warm colour stops are fixed, although classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
use_when: A warm golden-to-red field is wanted behind a hero, card or call to action.
avoid_when: It is static flat colour, and white text struggles against the bright yellow top.
customise: The two gradient stops are baked into the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight_why: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.

a11y.note: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it carries no information by itself.

polish_why: Smooth warm blend with clean rounded corners; still a stock two-colour gradient.
